svg.desc: Swimlane of each standard's own process
svg.text: Figure 1 · Where each standard sets its level and produces its evidence

One lane per standard, its own steps in order. Phase columns show where in each process a step happens, not that the steps or levels are equal. Evidence from a part's standard comes into Susanoo through the sourcing
Supplier evidence handed to the sourcing review
Generated by tools/crosswalk/build.py from standards/crosswalk.yaml. Steps and clauses are drafts until checked against each standard's text.

g.text: Terms: 1A–4F = risk assessment code, severity 1–4 plus probability A–F (e.g. 1C) · AI = artificial intelligence (here, an AI assistant drafting at independence level I0) · ARP4754B = SAE guidelines for development of civil aircraft and systems · ARP4761A = SAE guidelines

for the safety assessment process on civil aircraft · ASIL = Automotive Safety Integrity Level, QM and ASIL A–D (ISO 26262) · CCF = common cause failure · DAL = development assurance level (DO-178C / DO-254) · DC = direct current; in ISO 13849-1, diagnostic coverage

(DC_avg) · DIA = development interface agreement between customer and supplier (ISO 26262-8) · DO-178C = RTCA software considerations in airborne systems · DO-254 = RTCA design assurance for airborne electronic hardware · DoD = US Department of Defense · F-nnn = system

function in the item definition · FHA = functional hazard analysis (MIL-STD-882E Task 208; also ARP4761A aircraft FHA) · HFT = hardware fault tolerance (IEC 61508-2) · I0–I3 = review independence level (I0 none, e.g. the author or an AI, to I3 independent organisation) ·

IEC = International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC 61508 functional safety) · ISO = International Organization for Standardization (ISO 12100 machinery risk, ISO 13849 control safety, ISO 26262 road vehicles) · LFM = latent fault metric (ISO 26262-5) · MIL-STD-882E =

US DoD Standard Practice for System Safety (11 May 2012, base edition) · PFH = average frequency of a dangerous failure per hour (IEC 61508; PFH_D in ISO 13849-1) · PL = Program Lead (simulated role ROLE-PL); in ISO 13849-1, performance level PL a–e · PMHF =

probabilistic metric for random hardware failures, per hour (ISO 26262-5) · PSAC = Plan for Software Aspects of Certification (DO-178C) · PSSA = preliminary system safety assessment (ARP4761A) · QM = quality managed: no ASIL needed, normal quality management suffices

(ISO 26262) · RAC = risk assessment code, severity category plus probability level (e.g. 1C) · ROLE-nnn = project role in the tailoring record (simulated until the lead says otherwise) · RTCA = RTCA, Inc., publisher of DO-178C and DO-254 · SAE = SAE International,

publisher of ARP4754B and ARP4761A · SAR = safety assessment report (MIL-STD-882E Task 301) · SAS = Software Accomplishment Summary (DO-178C) · SCC = software control category (MIL-STD-882E Table IV) · SEooC = safety element out of context: a part developed to ISO 26262

against assumed conditions of use · SFF = safe failure fraction (IEC 61508-2) · SIL = safety integrity level, SIL 1–4 (IEC 61508) · SPFM = single-point fault metric (ISO 26262-5) · SRASW = safety-related application software (ISO 13849-1) · SRESW = safety-related
embedded software (ISO 13849-1) · SwCI = software criticality index (MIL-STD-882E Table V) · US = United States
